nodes.label: Anti-Slop UI Engine
nodes.summary: A comprehensive standard and rule engine to eliminate generic AI-generated slop in UI design, code quality, accessibility, security, and performance.

nodes.label: Brief Inference and Design Read
nodes.summary: Mandatory first step requiring extraction of product type, target audience, primary job, visual language, and brand anchors before generating UI code.

nodes.label: Three Parameter Dials
nodes.summary: Numeric configuration dials (DESIGN_VARIANCE, MOTION_INTENSITY, VISUAL_DENSITY on scale 1-10) controlling layout asymmetry, motion physics, and spacing density.

nodes.label: 4px Spacing Scale
nodes.summary: Strict 4px/0.25rem multiple spacing scale prohibiting arbitrary pixel values across margins, paddings, and layout gaps.

nodes.label: Asymmetric Padding Rule
nodes.summary: Enforces horizontal padding to be 1.25x to 1.5x larger than vertical padding for balanced visual proportions.

nodes.label: Hairline Border Token
nodes.summary: Subtle 1px solid border using rgba transparency instead of opaque solid gray borders.

nodes.label: Layered Micro-Shadow
nodes.summary: Subtle, multi-layer micro-shadow tokens with blur <= 16px and low opacity to prevent ballooned or floating card aesthetics.

nodes.label: Proportional Border-Radius
nodes.summary: Constrains corner radius to 4px-8px for small elements and 8px-12px for cards, prohibiting radii >= 16px on functional containers.

nodes.label: OKLCH Color Architecture
nodes.summary: Perceptually uniform color token system defined in CSS @theme supporting high contrast and reliable dark/light palette ramps.

nodes.label: 90/10 Palette Ratio Rule
nodes.summary: Enforces 90% neutral monochrome surface/background/border and exactly 10% single primary brand accent.

nodes.label: Character-Rich Typography Pairing
nodes.summary: Pairs distinctive Display/Heading fonts with refined Body fonts, banning standalone default Inter or Roboto.

nodes.label: Tabular Numerals Rule
nodes.summary: Mandates font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and right-alignment for financial, numeric, timestamp, and data table columns.

nodes.label: Five Interactive States Requirement
nodes.summary: Mandates explicit styling for default, hover, active (pressed), focus-visible, and disabled states on all interactive elements.

nodes.label: Restrained Motion and Snappy Easing
nodes.summary: Specifies 100-250ms duration limits with custom spring decelerate cubic-bezier curves instead of generic ease-in-out.

nodes.label: Prefers Reduced Motion Fallback
nodes.summary: Mandatory CSS media query override disabling transitions and animations for users requesting reduced motion.

nodes.label: Anti-Slop 20 Hard Bans
nodes.summary: List of 20 absolute prohibitions triggering auto-reject and rewrite if violated in UI code or design tokens.

nodes.label: Pre-Flight Audit Checklist
nodes.summary: Pre-generation verification list ensuring compliance across design reads, dial parameters, tokens, contrast, a11y, and security.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4
nodes.summary: CSS-first engine utilizing @theme block tokens for zero-runtime high-performance styling.

nodes.label: Next.js 15 App Router
nodes.summary: Modern React framework leveraging React Server Components for server-side data fetching and minimal client bundle overhead.

nodes.label: React 19 Primitives
nodes.summary: Modern React architecture using useActionState, useFormStatus, and native async promise handling.

nodes.label: Lucide Icons
nodes.summary: Consistent vector icon set with uniform stroke width used in place of decorative emojis or inconsistent icon sets.

nodes.label: Bento Grid Layout
nodes.summary: Asymmetric multi-cell grid composition showcasing distinct capabilities with varied card densities and visual hierarchies.

nodes.label: Dataset UI Archetypes
nodes.summary: Five empirical UI archetypes synthesized from 111 real-world dashboards and trading terminals.

nodes.label: Zero Code Slop Principles
nodes.summary: Code quality standards eliminating trivial wrapper functions, redundant type aliases, static-only classes, and chained assertions.

nodes.label: No Em-Dash / En-Dash Rule
nodes.summary: Strict prohibition of decorative em-dash (U+2014) and en-dash (U+2013) characters across code, comments, and UI text.

nodes.label: YAGNI and Minimal Effective Diff
nodes.summary: Philosophy favoring deletion over addition, native platform primitives over heavy libraries, and minimal working diffs.

nodes.label: Ponytail Comment Convention
nodes.summary: Comment format 'ponytail: <ceiling and upgrade path>' documenting deliberate code simplifications and trade-offs.

nodes.label: Minimum Touch Target (44x44px)
nodes.summary: WCAG and Apple HIG requirement ensuring interactive elements have a minimum active bounding area of 44x44px.

nodes.label: Persistent Form Labels
nodes.summary: Enforces permanent visible labels on form inputs, banning placeholder-as-label anti-patterns.

nodes.label: Edge Case States Handling
nodes.summary: Mandatory explicit implementations for Loading (skeleton), Empty (informative CTA), and Error (retry CTA) states.

nodes.label: Secrets and Credentials Isolation
nodes.summary: Prohibits AI agents from reading, editing, or committing .env files, private keys, or raw secrets.

nodes.label: Standardized Authentication Libraries
nodes.summary: Bans custom handwritten auth systems in favor of vetted libraries like NextAuth/Auth.js, Clerk, Supabase Auth, or Lucia.

nodes.label: Zod Runtime Schema Validation
nodes.summary: Mandatory server-side boundary validation for API inputs, server actions, and environment variables.

nodes.label: Parameterized Database Queries
nodes.summary: Mandates ORM query builders (Drizzle, Prisma, Kysely) to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities.

nodes.label: Mandatory Search Debounce
nodes.summary: Requires 250ms-400ms debounce on live search, autocomplete, and filter inputs to prevent API flooding.

nodes.label: Zero N+1 Query Optimization
nodes.summary: Requires eager joins, batch loaders, and prohibits database queries inside map/forEach loops.

nodes.label: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) Prevention
nodes.summary: Enforces explicit aspect-ratios, min-h-[100dvh] viewport stability, and static skeleton placeholders.

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Workflow
nodes.summary: 4-stage development process (Spec, Plan, Execute, Verify) dedicating 70% effort to specification and verification.

nodes.label: Jackhammer, Chisel, and Inspection Triad
nodes.summary: Iterative workflow model balancing fast AI prototyping (jackhammer), manual refinement (chisel), and CI/CD quality gates (inspection).

nodes.label: Visual Direction Presets
nodes.summary: Curated design aesthetic presets including Cold Luxury, Editorial Kinetic, Bento Box Modular, Terminal NOC, and Translucent Glass.

nodes.label: Restrained Translucent Glass Token
nodes.summary: Constrained glassmorphism style reserved only for floating headers, modal overlays, or media panels, requiring reduced-transparency fallback.

nodes.label: Linear Design Archetype
nodes.summary: Design benchmark featuring quiet chrome, near-monochrome palette, 1px dividers, and keyboard-first interactions.

nodes.label: Stripe Design Archetype
nodes.summary: Design benchmark centering data tables, tabular numerals, inline sparklines, and drill-down drawer interactions.

nodes.label: Vercel Design Archetype
nodes.summary: Design benchmark emphasizing pure monochrome typography, spacing, border hierarchy, and status-only color accents.
